notes:
Lead profile: small regional e-commerce marketplace focused on home goods and gifts. Inbound via blog post about catalog embeddings + search. Self-serve signup; used free trial credits to run enrichment job. Key pain: manual product descriptions are inconsistent across merchants -> want automated title/description normalization and attribute extraction. Use cases: product Q&A widget on PDPs (customer-facing), back-office catalog enrichment (metadata, tags), and chat-based agent for merchant onboarding.

Performance & traffic profile: baseline traffic small (200-500 reqs/day) but very bursty on weekend promos and local 'market day' events — spikes up to 20-50x for short windows (10-30 mins). Concern: token costs during bursts and API rate limits. Latency target: <=200ms for title autocompletion and <=400ms for multi-turn product Q&A. Throughput: occasional sustained bursts of 500-1k RPS for short periods.

Model preferences: open to mid-sized open models for cost reasons; wants the ability to fallback to cheaper variants under load. Interested in embeddings for search/categorization. Cost sensitivity high; wants guidance on batching, prefix caching, and discounting/burst policies.

Security/compliance: SMB but wants SSO (SAML) for admin users, basic audit_logging for changes, and data retention controls for merchant data. No air-gapped/on-prem needs — public cloud ok.

Quotes / snippets: "We love how fast the index builds were — just want to make sure we don't get bill-shocked during a flash sale."

Open items: confirmer on token-counting on combined prompt+context, request for 30-day trial extension, ask for sample rate-limit policy for bursty patterns. SE (Priya) to run a small load test with quota bump. AE (Jordan) to propose starter commitment if trial shows stable unit costs.
